summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution to cancel 14,262,733 common shares held as treasury shares, with an estimated book value of KRW 1,402,230,461,984 (~KRW 98,310 per share). The cancellation, set for May 15, 2026, is conducted under Article 343-1 of the Korean Commercial Code and does not reduce paid-in capital. This is comparable to a U.S. capital return event (share retirement). No premium or advisor is mentioned. Investors should watch for changes in the scheduled date due to regulatory consultations and the impact on earnings per share and return on equity. The risk-arb angle is minimal, as this is a standard capital allocation move.
